title: HSK1 Gate 8 · Three Kingdoms
explanationEn: Gate 8: Three Kingdoms. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第8关：三国。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 三国时候，中国有三个国。三个国常常打来打去。诸葛亮是一位很有智慧的人。他很会想办法，也很会看天气。
passageEn: During the Three Kingdoms period, China had three kingdoms. The three kingdoms fought each other again and again. Zhuge Liang was a person of great wisdom. He was good at finding a way, and good at reading the weather.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: During the Three Kingdoms period, China had three kingdoms.
comprehension.answer: 三国时候，中国有三个国。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Zhuge Liang was a person of great wisdom.
comprehension.answer: 诸葛亮是一位很有智慧的人。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 时 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“时”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 时 (shí) means "time" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “时”（shí）的意思是“time”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 候 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“候”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 候 (hòu) means "period" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “候”（hòu）的意思是“period”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 三国时候，中国有三个国。

options.text: The water was very big; many people had no home.
During the Three Kingdoms period, China had three kingdoms.
Long ago, the waters of China were very high.

check.explanationEn: "三国时候，中国有三个国。" means "During the Three Kingdoms period, China had three kingdoms.".
check.explanation: “三国时候，中国有三个国。”的意思是“During the Three Kingdoms period, China had three kingdoms.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Three Kingdoms in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说三国。
